purpose: v6 successor of the vmdel lane (d4f die: vmdel_<Q><b> x32, slot 257.04x151.2 in region vmh_<Q>). v5b hv15_vmdel_lane-hv15-20b84db92 CLOSED TT +49.22 / FF +10.13 but NATIVE FAIL (results/rtl/hbm_lane_a_1017/native_1017.json): launch 346.6 > 220 on dq[264..266] (= bank_id strap: in -> dq flop -> N pin, one flop between a W pin and an N pin), capture 274.2 on rst_n (async clears of 18 flops) + fill_data_i 42 pins 190-198 + full*/pcbad_all 21 pins to 227 (8-lane AND/OR in front of the pin flop), R 286.7 / spread 96.4 > 80 (clk pin at W y~40 beside SRAM 0). Structural fix v6: (1) every input pin -> D of one plain pin flop, incl. rst_n (rst_s) and bank_id (bank_q), so dq[266:264] are plain N-face output flops; (2) synchronous body reset from rst_s (no async clear anywhere, release timing unchanged; a status_live flop flushes stale captured cross-lane status on release; the 512 seen bits are unreset: cleared by the bank's accepted begin before any fill can be accepted); (3) the 24 cross-lane status bits captured raw at the W pins, AND/OR after the flop (STATUS_LAT=2 unchanged); (4) one clock root, clk pin moved to W y=75.6 on the horizontal channel between the 2x2 SRAM grid, so the trunk enters the centre cross and branches symmetrically to the S fill band and the N dq band; W ports ranged so the clk slot is exclusive. RTL body = Codex candidate 25a390064 with its second (clk_cap) root removed: port list unchanged, die binding unchanged. Cycles: interface LAT=2, STATUS_LAT=2, II=1: +0 cycles (compiler offsets owner H-NETLIST: no change). Bench: tools/hbm_v15_harden/bench_delivery_v6.sh (production delivery + typed protocol lockstep vs monolithic #(STATUS_LAT=2) + per-lane clock ownership + invalid-payload consumer non-interference); mutants group select, SRAM slot, late reset release, status pin flops bypassed, collapsed lane clocks FAIL (Icarus 11 and 12). The every-bit comparator differs only in valid=0 payload after a reset asserted mid-read (synchronous reset), typed-protocol policy of main 782dca30d.
